name: Pullman Khao Lak Resort
short_description: A 253-room, 5-star all-inclusive-optional beachfront resort on Bang Muang Beach with four pools and a large kids' club.
ai_summary: Pullman Khao Lak Resort is a five-star beachfront property on gently sloping Bang Muang Beach in Khao Lak, about 90 minutes (roughly 100 km) north of Phuket International Airport. Its 253 rooms, family suites and pool villas are set around four pools, including an infinity pool and water slide, plus one of Khao Lak's largest kids' clubs at over 1,000 sqm, and a genuine "Taste of Paradise" all-inclusive package covering meals, unlimited drinks and a couples' massage. Guests consistently praise the resort's family-friendly facilities, spacious rooms and beachfront setting, though recent reviews flag inconsistent service and breakfast quality on some stays, and the remote location keeps guests dependent on the resort for evening options.

faqs.question: Is Pullman Khao Lak Resort all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: It offers an optional "Taste of Paradise" all-inclusive package covering buffet meals, unlimited drinks from noon to 10pm, and a one-time 60-minute couples' massage, rather than being all-inclusive by default.

faqs.question: How many rooms does Pullman Khao Lak Resort have?
faqs.answer: The resort has 253 rooms and pool villas, spanning Deluxe Rooms, Family Suites, a Presidential Suite, and 1-Bedroom Luxury Pool Villas, some with direct beachfront access, giving couples, families, and larger groups a range of accommodation styles to choose from within the same property.
